name: Germany
dossier:
The Germany national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Die Mannschaft, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 9 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A fallen giant rebuilt around two of the most exciting playmakers on the planet.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Germany will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group E and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group E. The connection between Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Jamal Musiala - the clinical playmaker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Germany are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Germany crashed out in the group stage in BOTH 2018 and 2022  -  a four-time champion in crisis seeks redemption.
Germany boast 4 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (x4).
